feature: In-progress sequences and hidden edits keep a worktree
expected: A paused sequence counts as in progress.
Edits hidden from status by index flags make a worktree not clean.

contains: Check every worktree, including detached ones.
No entry of `git -C <worktree> ls-files -v` is tagged `S` (skip-worktree) or with a lowercase letter (assume-unchanged) while its file exists on disk
for the main worktree the result is relative to `<worktree>`, so resolve it against that path before testing whether it exists
